name: _scan_fields
header:
@staticmethod
    def _scan_fields(
        t: Mapping, fields: Iterable[str], ns: str
    ) -> MutableMapping[str, Any]:
        """Reads meta fields from a schem object.

        Args:
            t (Mapping): Target to scan for fields.
            fields (Iterable): List of fields to accept.
            ns (str): Field namespace (separated by .).

        Returns:
            Mapping: Field values.
        """

[build-system]
requires = [ "setuptools~=75.3.0", "setuptools-scm~=8.1.0",]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
name = "dbt-metabase"
description = "dbt + Metabase integration."
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.10"
dependencies = [ "PyYAML>=5.4.1", "requests>=2.26.0", "click>=8.0.0", "rich>=12.0.0",]
dynamic = [ "version",]
classifiers = [ "Intended Audience :: Developers", "License :: OSI Approved :: MIT License", "Operating System :: OS Independent", "Programming Language :: Python", "Programming Language :: Python :: 3 :: Only", "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.8", "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.9", "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.10", "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.11", "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.12", "Topic :: Software Development :: Libraries", "Topic :: Software Development :: Libraries :: Python Modules",]
version = "0.1.0"
[[project.authors]]
name = "Mike Gouline"

[dependency-groups]
dev = [ "build>=1.0.3", "twine>=4.0.2", "ruff>=0.5.5", "pyright>=1.1.405", "pytest>=8.3.1", "molot~=1.0.0", "dbt-core~=1.10.1", "dbt-postgres~=1.9.0", "python-dotenv~=1.0.1", "types-requests", "types-PyYAML",]

[project.license]
text = "MIT License"

[project.scripts]
dbt-metabase = "dbtmetabase.__main__:cli"

[project.urls]
Homepage = "https://github.com/gouline/dbt-metabase"

[tool.setuptools]
packages = [ "dbtmetabase",]

[tool.setuptools_scm]
version_file = "dbtmetabase/_version.py"

[tool.poetry]
[[tool.poetry.packages]]
include = "dbtmetabase"

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = [ "E", "W", "F", "I", "A", "B", "C4", "FIX001",]
ignore = [ "E501", "F403",]

[tool.poetry.group.dev.dependencies]
pytest-cov = "^7.0.0"
pytest-reportlog = "^0.4.0"
pytest-env = "^1.2.0"
icontract = "^2.7.1"
python-dotenv = "^1.2.1"
